# RawInputEnabled

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Mouse](BlitzBasic-Mouse)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RawInputEnabled:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 if raw input was asked for, otherwise 0 (the initial value). It says what was asked for, not whether the platform can do it; that is [HWRawInput](HWRawInput).

## Description

Tells what [RawInput](RawInput) was last set to.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Related Commands

[DirectInputEnabled](DirectInputEnabled), [EnableDirectInput](EnableDirectInput), [HWRawInput](HWRawInput), [RawInput](RawInput)
